name: manifest_finalize
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();exclude=set(json.loads((p/'MANIFEST-EXCLUSIONS.json').read_text())['exact_terminal_non_circular_exclusions']);files=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not f.is_file():continue
 rel=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if rel in exclude:continue
 files.append({'path':rel,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':f.stat().st_size})
assert json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256SUMS.json'],input=json.dumps({'files':files,'excluded':sorted(exclude),'classification':'FAIL_QUARANTINE; documentary integrity only, no scientific eligibility'},indent=2)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'frozen_after_count':13,'frozen_mismatches':0,'status':'FAIL_QUARANTINE','qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'SHA256SUMS.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
